detailed_description:
・Game Overview

- Ver 1.3.0 Update: Toon Style Added!

Now you can freely switch Luna's look between realistic and anime-inspired styles to match your mood and the scene.

During gameplay, you can toggle her appearance with either the Real Style / Toon Style button or by pressing the "Y" key.

The "Luna the Specialized Sexual Care Nurse" series, with over 2,000 copies sold, is now available as a simulation game!

Cowgirl position-Fellatio-Missionary position-Doggy style-Prone bone-Seated face-to-face
Featuring a wide variety of positions.
Supports pause, fast-forward, and reverse playback so you can enjoy your favorite scenes exactly the way you like.
Includes approximately 45 minutes of rich content.
Supports up to 3840×2160 resolution at 60fps.
An immersive and intense video experience you'll want to enjoy over and over again.

・Story & Situations
Set in a hospital room and hallway.
In the room, Luna-chan dedicates herself to serving you, the patient admitted to the specialized sexual care ward.
In the hallway, you witness a provocative adult film being shot, full of forbidden tension.
This unique hospital setting enhances the realism and immersive atmosphere.

・High Degree of Control & Customization
Easily switch camera angles with mouse clicks or keyboard shortcuts.
Includes various customization options such as love hotel-style lighting, skin tone adjustments, and male character invisibility.
Replay your favorite scenes from any angle you like.

・Realistic Textures with Unreal Engine 5
Built with next-gen game engine Unreal Engine 5, offering realistic lighting and natural textures.

・Full Voice Acting for Enhanced Immersion
Sensual and sweet voice acting brings out Luna-chan's full charm.
Her whispers in your ear will draw you deep into the experience.
